title: HistoryRevisionsPruneRequest
description: Explicit history pruning for one (scope, entity_kind, entity_id) target (spoke-history). Retains the newest keep checkpoints (the live row is not a checkpoint and never consumes keep); no write path prunes implicitly. Requires the negotiated spoke-history capability. Authorization is exactly the entity write (put) permission in the same scope — no history_admin grant, no history-specific refusal code. Mutating op: idempotency_key is required at the wire level (absent answers INVALID_INPUT); dedup namespace (scope, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key); same-key different-digest answers IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; replay against an evicted outcome answers RECEIPT_EXPIRED.

entity_kind.description: Open kind selector. Core vocabulary (documented, not enforced): knowledge_entry, relation.

keep.description: Number of newest checkpoints to retain, excluding the live row.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1-128 characters; unique within the dedup namespace (scope, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key).
idempotency_key.title: IdempotencyKey

scope.description: Scope in which entity lookup and write authorization are evaluated; also the effective scope selector in the dedup namespace.
